job.job_description:
Generative AI Engineer (Gen AI, LLM & Prompt Engineering)

Location: Chennai
Experience: 3+ Years




Introduction

We are looking for a passionate and innovative Generative AI Engineer with 3+ years of experience in designing and developing AI-powered applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building intelligent solutions using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, RAG architectures, and vector databases to solve real-world business challenges.




Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Create and optimize prompts to improve AI model accuracy, relevance, and performance.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and semantic search techniques.
Integrate OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and open-source LLMs into enterprise applications.
Develop AI-powered chatbots, virtual assistants, and content generation solutions.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to identify AI use cases and deliver scalable solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and enhance LLM performance for domain-specific requirements.
Implement API integrations and backend services for AI applications.
Ensure adherence to AI governance, security, and responsible AI practices.
Stay up to date with the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, and Prompt Engineering.



Preferred Candidate

3+ years of experience in AI/ML, NLP, or Generative AI development.
Strong expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, and Prompt Engineering.
Hands-on experience with OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG frameworks.
Proficiency in Python and AI application development.
Experience working with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, or Weaviate.
Good understanding of NLP, embeddings, semantic search, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP (Preferred).
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Experience in fine-tuning open-source LLMs and building enterprise AI solutions is an added advantage.



Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days Preferred.
